description: Answer a swap: approve or decline one proposed to the current user, or withdraw one they proposed. Approve moves cards in both collections at once: each copy given leaves its owner (the claims it no longer fits released, and named), each copy received lands in Unsorted as a trade. Without confirm: true, approve is a dry run: show the user what they give, receive and what would_release names, and ask before confirming. `add_to` ticks, for a card the user receives, the deck of theirs that claims it: only on the user's say-so. Refused, with nothing moved, when a copy is gone or changed since the proposal. Decline and withdraw move nothing.

deck.description: Deck id or name: one of the decks that miss the card

confirm.description: approve only: true to move the cards; without it nothing moves
